source: USD per minute of each label's standard SKU in a private repository (actions_linux, actions_linux_arm, actions_windows, actions_macos), from https://docs.github.com/en/billing/reference/actions-runner-pricing as read on 2026-11-18. Standard runners are free on public repositories (https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/runners/github-hosted-runners), where they have 4 cores: the charge is what the same minutes would cost a private repository.
